reviewer.chosen_by: Dr Laurence E. Day, in the reviewer question of the decision comment
reviewer.boundary: an agent session with no authorship of the record, given read-only instructions and no permission to edit. It is not a GitHub review and not a human reviewer.

method: two rounds. Each checked every file:line against the named file at the named commit, recomputed every digest and byte count, confirmed each topic0 literal is present inside the named emit_ function and equals cast keccak of its declared signature, re-ran the branch relations and the carrier survey, and read the emit sites to judge each actor class. Round two also enumerated every caller of every emit-bearing function across all 118 src/ paths at the candidate.
